newsitem.title: FRANCE: BoF's Marchelli sees 14 EU countries ready for EMU.
newsitem.headline: BoF's Marchelli sees 14 EU countries ready for EMU.

text.p: Bank of France Monetary Policy Council member Paul Marchelli said on Friday that 14 countries would be ready to enter a single European currency in 1998.
"There are 14 countries that will be admissible next year," he said. He said southern European countries would be part of the first group of countries taking part in the single currency.

"As for the well-known southern countries, this "Club Med" that I hear spoken about, they will be in the group. It was never imaginable that we could build Europe on a north/south fracture," he said in an interview with LCI cable television.

On Monday, EU finance ministers in Brussels approved a sharply worded Commission report on the state of Italy's finances suggesting that many of the measures taken recently to slash its budget deficit were not sustainable.
